areas.name: Indigenous and quilombola peoples
areas.reason: General objective not directly related; a few conservation and heritage products only indirectly benefit traditional populations, so impact potential is low.

areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: Green infrastructure, nature-based drainage and bike paths link to sanitation and mobility; impact moderate given the limited share of resources in related products.

areas.name: Environment
areas.reason: General objective is biodiversity conservation; most specific objectives and products are direct, with nature-based solutions and protected-area creation; resources significant and impact high.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: Conservation products protect ecosystems acting as natural flood barriers, but only indirectly; resources indirectly linked, so impact potential is low.

areas.name: Water security
areas.reason: Nature-based stormwater management and a water-quality target are relevant; impact moderate because related products weigh little in the total program.

areas.name: Tourism
areas.reason: Ecotourism objective and indicator align, but infrastructure only indirectly linked to the area and no direct components; impact low.

areas.name: Creative economy
areas.reason: A cultural museum product exists, but no targets for this area; the indicator offered measures community environmental education and was counted under environment.

areas.name: Sport
areas.reason: No components, indicators or targets aimed at sport access; the bike-path indicator was used for sustainable cities instead.

areas.name: Labor
areas.reason: Green-jobs objective is not reflected in the scope; infrastructure is not centered on employment, and related elements were used for tourism.

areas.name: Transparency and participation
areas.reason: Participation objective exists, but only physical centers are delivered, with no permanent participatory governance mechanisms; the indicator was counted under environment.

not_accepted.name: Creative economy
not_accepted.reason: A cultural museum product exists, but no targets for this area; the indicator offered measures community environmental education and was counted under environment.

not_accepted.reason: No components, indicators or targets aimed at sport access; the bike-path indicator was used for sustainable cities instead.

not_accepted.name: Labor
not_accepted.reason: Green-jobs objective is not reflected in the scope; infrastructure is not centered on employment, and related elements were used for tourism.

not_accepted.name: Transparency and participation
not_accepted.reason: Participation objective exists, but only physical centers are delivered, with no permanent participatory governance mechanisms; the indicator was counted under environment.

bonus.reason: Proponent claimed deforestation and climate priorities, but products tied to them cover only about half of program resources, so full allocation was not shown.
Proponent did not state the program promotes regional integration.
